name: movie_regulus_isi_oblate
label: Movie: Regulus's oblateness with the three ISI trucks in a triangle at 650 nm, two nights
notes: Regulus is 32 % oblate (McAlister et al. 2005: 1.65 x 1.25 mas, equator at PA 175.5 deg, i ~ 90). Triangle of 70 m sides (null of the equal-area disk at 114 m), rotated by 30 deg on the second night.
Expected: ~20 sigma per night, sigma(q) 0.09 -> ~0.065 after two nights (q - 1 = 0.32 at ~5 sigma).
